description: Design the voice user experience for a conversational application from persona through dialog flow to usability testing.

steps.description: Define the voice persona including tone, pace, vocabulary, and personality traits.

inputs.name: brand-identity
inputs.desc: Brand values, target audience, and personality guidelines

inputs.name: use-case-context
inputs.desc: Primary tasks the voice will handle and the environment (phone, smart speaker, in-car)

outputs.name: voice-persona
outputs.desc: Defined persona with name, tone, pace, vocabulary level, and personality traits

outputs.name: voice-style-guide
outputs.desc: Guidelines for prompt writing, error handling tone, and escalation language

process: Define the persona attributes (warm vs. professional, formal vs. casual, fast vs. measured).
Match the persona to the brand identity and target audience expectations.
Write the voice style guide with example prompts, error messages, and escalation scripts.

steps.description: Design the dialog flows for each task the voice application handles.

outputs.name: dialog-flows
outputs.desc: Complete dialog trees for each task with user intents, system responses, and branching logic

outputs.name: error-recovery-flows
outputs.desc: Flows for misunderstanding, silence, and out-of-scope requests

process: Map the happy path for each task (user says X, system responds Y, user confirms Z).
Add branching for alternate intents and slot-filling variations.
Design error recovery: misrecognition, silence timeout, disambiguation, and graceful fallback.
Write the exact prompts for each node in the persona's voice.

steps.description: Build a testable prototype of the voice experience.

outputs.name: voice-prototype
outputs.desc: Interactive prototype or script that walks through the dialog flows

outputs.name: test-scenarios
outputs.desc: Scenarios covering happy paths, errors, edge cases, and adversarial inputs

process: Implement the dialog flows in a prototyping tool or script.
Record or synthesize audio for each system prompt.
Write the test scenarios covering normal use, errors, and edge cases.

steps.description: Test the voice prototype with users and produce findings.

outputs.name: usability-findings
outputs.desc: Issues found, severity, and frequency across testers

outputs.name: voice-ux-report
outputs.desc: Complete report with persona, flows, test results, and recommended changes

process: Run the test scenarios with representative users.
Record where users got confused, abandoned, or needed to repeat themselves.
Classify issues by severity and frequency.
Compile the report with the persona, flows, test results, and prioritized fixes.

description: Design an IVR phone tree from menu structure through prompt scripting to testing.

steps.description: Map the menu structure and routing logic for the phone tree.

inputs.name: call-types
inputs.desc: Types of calls the system handles (sales, support, billing, hours, location)

inputs.name: routing-destinations
inputs.desc: Where each call type should end up (agent group, voicemail, self-service, callback)

outputs.name: menu-tree
outputs.desc: Hierarchical menu structure with options at each level and routing targets

outputs.name: routing-rules
outputs.desc: Business hours, overflow, and failover routing for each destination

process: List all call types and their frequency to set the menu order.
Design the menu hierarchy (keep depth to 3 levels or fewer).
Define the routing for each leaf node including business hours, queue, and failover.

steps.description: Write the audio prompts for each menu node.

outputs.name: prompt-scripts
outputs.desc: Word-for-word scripts for each greeting, menu, hold, and error prompt

outputs.name: recording-plan
outputs.desc: List of all prompts to record, with talent and session requirements

process: Write the main greeting, after-hours greeting, and holiday greeting.
Write each menu prompt with clear options and timing.
Write hold messages, transfer announcements, and voicemail greetings.
Compile the recording plan with all scripts, estimated duration, and talent notes.

steps.description: Test every path through the phone tree and produce the deployment document.

outputs.name: test-results
outputs.desc: Pass/fail for each path with issues found

outputs.name: phone-tree-document
outputs.desc: Complete phone tree documentation with menus, prompts, routing, and test results

process: Call through every menu path and verify the routing.
Test business hours, after-hours, and holiday routing.
Verify hold times, callback, and failover behavior.
Compile the phone tree document for operations.

description: Set up analytics for conversational AI from metric definition through dashboard to optimization.

steps.description: Define the metrics that measure conversational AI performance.

inputs.name: conversational-channels
inputs.desc: Channels to measure (voice, chat, email, social)

inputs.name: business-goals
inputs.desc: What success looks like (resolution rate, containment, satisfaction, cost per contact)

outputs.name: metric-catalog
outputs.desc: Defined metrics with formulas, data sources, and targets

outputs.name: data-collection-plan
outputs.desc: What data to capture from each channel and how

process: Define the core metrics (containment rate, escalation rate, resolution rate, average handle time, CSAT).
Add the intent-level metrics (recognition accuracy, slot fill rate, task completion rate per intent).
Map each metric to its data source and collection method.

steps.description: Build the analytics dashboard for monitoring conversational AI performance.

outputs.name: analytics-dashboard
outputs.desc: Dashboard configuration with charts, filters, and drill-downs

outputs.name: alert-rules
outputs.desc: Alerts for metric thresholds that need attention

process: Design the dashboard layout: summary at top, channel breakdowns, intent-level detail.
Configure the data connections and refresh intervals.
Set alert thresholds for metric degradation (drop in containment, spike in escalation).

steps.description: Analyze the data and recommend optimizations.

outputs.name: optimization-recommendations
outputs.desc: Prioritized list of changes to improve performance

outputs.name: conversational-analytics-report
outputs.desc: Complete report with metrics, trends, and action items

process: Identify the lowest-performing intents by resolution rate and volume.
Analyze the most common escalation paths and failure points.
Recommend dialog changes, training data additions, and routing adjustments.
Compile the report with metrics, trends, and prioritized recommendations.

description: Set up voice biometric authentication from enrollment through verification to fraud detection.

steps.description: Design the voiceprint enrollment process for callers.

inputs.name: authentication-requirements
inputs.desc: Security level needed and regulatory constraints

outputs.name: enrollment-flow
outputs.desc: Step-by-step enrollment process (passphrase, free-speech, or hybrid)

outputs.name: enrollment-scripts
outputs.desc: Prompts and instructions for callers during enrollment

process: Choose the enrollment method (text-dependent passphrase, text-independent free speech, or hybrid).
Design the enrollment flow with the minimum audio needed for a reliable voiceprint.
Write the caller prompts that guide enrollment naturally within an existing call.

steps.description: Configure the verification engine thresholds and decision logic.

inputs.name: authentication-requirements
inputs.desc: Acceptable false accept and false reject rates

outputs.name: verification-config
outputs.desc: Thresholds, decision logic, and fallback authentication for low-confidence scores

outputs.name: security-policy
outputs.desc: Policy for score handling, step-up authentication, and data retention

process: Set the score threshold to balance false accept rate against false reject rate.
Configure step-up authentication for borderline scores (knowledge questions, OTP).
Define the data retention and deletion policies for voiceprints.

steps.description: Configure fraud detection for spoofing, replay, and synthetic voice attacks.

outputs.name: fraud-detection-rules
outputs.desc: Rules for detecting replay attacks, voice synthesis, and channel manipulation

outputs.name: voice-biometrics-document
outputs.desc: Complete setup document covering enrollment, verification, fraud detection, and policy

process: Configure replay detection (audio hash comparison, liveness checks).
Configure synthetic voice detection (spectral analysis, artifact detection).
Set up alerting for detected fraud attempts.
Compile the complete voice biometrics document.
